thread:
maya: Starting bring-up for model atlas-2b-int8. Plan: shadow=atlas-2b-fp16 (capture), canary 5% -> 20% over 4h if signals look good. Need quick alignment on gating signals and auto-fallback thresholds.

sam: Note — int8 showed ~1.8% drop on long-context QA F1 in local eval suite v3. Shorter prompts are fine. We should protect answer-quality metrics first.

oliver: +1 on protecting QA. Suggest quiet-burn of 30m at each step to avoid noisy early spikes. Also capture p95 latency and token-rate.

li: Can we add embeddings drift check? For retrieval flows int8 sometimes shifts embedding norm. Propose cosine similarity gate: mean_cosine >= 0.985 vs baseline.

kevin: Also add a suffix-cache hit-rate check — some prompts rely on prefix KV behavior. If kv_cache_hit_rate drops > 5% we should pause.

maya: Proposed rollout snippet (will patch into rollout config):
```yaml
rollout:
  mode: gradual
  initial: 0.05
  step: 0.05
  step_interval: 1h
  quiet_burn: 30m
  checks:
    - name: eval.delta_f1
      threshold: -1.0
      comparator: less_than
    - name: latency.p95_increase_ms
      threshold: 50
      comparator: greater_than
    - name: error_rate_percent
      threshold: 0.5
      comparator: greater_than
    - name: embeddings.mean_cosine
      threshold: 0.985
      comparator: less_than
    - name: kv_cache.hit_rate_drop_pct
      threshold: 5
      comparator: greater_than
  on_failure: rollback_to: atlas-2b-fp16
  on_ambiguous: hold_and_notify: true
```

sam: For auto-fallback, let's be conservative first 2h: tighten eval.delta_f1 to -0.5 and require 2 consecutive windows before rollback. After 2h relax to -1.0 single-window.

oliver: Agree. Also add smoke test for hallucination: sample 100 prompts from production-shadow and run hallucination-detector; fail if hallucination_rate increases by >0.3%.

li: We'll need offline human spot-checks. Recommend flagging 1/1000 requests for human review during canary and send to label queue.

kevin: One more: ensure quantized model exposes quant-stats in trace logs so eval-bot can pick it up: "quant.per_token_qerror" and "quant layer skew".

eval-bot: scheduled-eval: run_id=deploy-1769004321, eval_suite=v3, compare=atlas-2b-fp16 vs atlas-2b-int8, report_channel=#eng-ml in ~18m.

deploy-bot: Canary started: atlas-2b-int8 @ 5% traffic, shadow=atlas-2b-fp16, capture=true, run_id=deploy-1769004321.

maya: I'll patch the rollout config with tightened first-2h rules and start the stepped canary at 14:00 PT. Will notify infra if we need extra buffer GPUs.

sam: If eval-bot shows 0.8%-1.5% F1 drop but latency improves a lot we might consider targeted routing: critical QA routes stay on fp16 until relabeling done.

oliver: +1 on targeted routing. Add route-based kill-switch: route.metric_override -> force fp16.

maya: Great — thanks. I'll open a short PR with the rollout yaml and add the human-spot-check ticket. Will update here when the first quiet-burn completes. :thumbsup:
